name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: A tavern keeper sends you to Commander Samaul in Theramore, where Hendel may still be stationed.

sections.title: A Lead in Theramore
sections.body: The tavern keeper believes Hendel is among the Kul Tiras Marines who visit regularly. They are paid at the beginning of each month and usually leave Theramore afterward. Commander Samaul may know if Hendel is still stationed there. Mention Elling's name, and Samaul may help discreetly.

sections.title: Samaul's Warning
sections.body: Commander Samaul is the officer in charge of Miss Proudmoore's forces in Theramore. He is busy, but offers to answer your questions. The marsh beyond the city holds ogres, orcs and murlocs. Black dragons dwell in its southern reaches.

faq.answer: Hendel is a Kul Tiras Marine who may be among the regular visitors to a tavern. The tavern keeper thinks Commander Samaul in Theramore may know if Hendel is still stationed there.
Commander Samaul is in charge of Miss Proudmoore's forces in Theramore.

faq.q: Why am I looking for Samaul?
faq.answer: The tavern keeper believes Samaul may help you find Hendel if Hendel is still stationed in Theramore.
The tavern keeper advises you to mention Elling's name when you ask Commander Samaul about Hendel.

faq.q: When do the Kul Tiras Marines leave Theramore?
faq.answer: The Kul Tiras Marines are paid at the beginning of each month and usually leave Theramore afterward.
Samaul warns of ogres, orcs and murlocs in the marsh beyond the city, and black dragons in its southern reaches.
